comment: Ms.Brenning is great! She has super clear criteria for all the assignments, and it is a pretty easy grader. I found her class very interesting, and she combines lectures with group discussions and activities. Not much homework, was never stressed about this class. I felt like I learned a lot and her teaching style is very clear.

I was exploring an Education major but realized it wasn't for me. Dr. Brenning is very sweet, but lectures can sometimes be a little boring. She is very passionate about the subject and tries to switch up teaching styles to keep students engaged. You will do great if you do not procrastinate the weekly reflections or projects.

Dr. Brenning is a fantastic teacher!! She is very available outside of class and very willing to help if you are struggling. Her class was very straight forward and interesting. No tests or quizzes, all projects and writing that are engaging and fun to complete. Overall, she is a great professor and I would recommend taking a class with her.

Dr. Brenning is an amazing person and teacher. I was always excited to go to class. No tests or quizzes, only projects. Final project is a 15 minute presentation for the class. She shares her personal teaching experiences to give you an idea of the real-world application of the information given. If you work hard and participate, you will do well.

No tests or quizzes, just papers and projects. Gives great feedback on assignments. Participate in class discussions! Makes lectures engaging and fun. Always available outside of class to help you out. Such an amazing person and teacher.
She's a great professor who is excited about the material and made me want to learn about what she was teaching

Dr. Brenning is the nicest and most reasonable professor. If you do the assignments,follow the directions, and participate in class discussions this is an easy A. She is super accommodating if you need extra help or need an extension. She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Just show up and complete the few assignments!
Dr. Brenning is an amazing professor! Classes are very informative, interesting, and interactive. She is a very fair grader and gives good feedback on papers.

Have to disagree with the previous review, Dr. Brenning is awesome! You can tell how passionate she is about teaching and really cares about all of her students. She gives clear guidelines for all assignments and is a fair grader. Yes, she expects that you come to class and participate, but who doesn't? Class is always full of activities!

Abuses an incredibly unstructured participation grade to give you whatever final grade she wants. Talk every class and get a 70 for participation. Actual grades on assignments are irrelevant, take with caution.
